description: This file defines a React functional component 'PromptTable' for rendering a table of prompt data, including features like sorting, copying IDs, displaying provider logos, and administrative actions like deletion. It handles data fetching from a model hub API and uses various UI libraries for rendering and interaction.

methods.name: PromptTable
methods.description: Main React component rendering a table of prompts with sortable columns, copy-to-clipboard, and admin actions. Fetches model hub data on mount.

methods.description: Formats date strings into a localized string or returns '-' if invalid.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies given text to the system clipboard.
